items.title: btc_dashboard tile status dot stays green while offline
items.resolution: HomeViewModel uses its latest poll result for live status; HomeViewModelTest covers good-to-dead polls.

items.title: BTC tile shows "0" instead of "––" when the block height is unknown
items.resolution: Unknown block height uses intOrDash; covered by HomeViewModelTest.

items.title: BTC tile re-fetches on every return to Home, not on a 60 s cadence
items.resolution: Home polls no more often than once per 60 seconds; covered by HomeViewModelTest.

items.title: Identity switch via nsec import or Amber/NIP-46 connect keeps the old identity's platform and humanity proofs
items.resolution: Synchronous identity hook binds each durable proof generation to the intended next identity before key persistence. All proof writes check both inside the transaction; reads/export/publishing reject foreign ownership. 136 proof tests cover old writes released after the new identity commits fresh proofs; eight identity barrier regressions pass.

items.title: Create result snackbar is lost if the user leaves the platform proof screen while the signer is open
items.resolution: Completion feedback uses the app snackbar controller; ViewModel and screen tests cover route removal.

items.title: Verify-string screen still says the platform-proof signature was checked (S-9 fix only half done)
items.resolution: Removed unsupported signature-verification claims in de/en/es; ReputationScreensUiTest covers the honest result text.

items.title: Export share fallback reports success when the share chooser could not be started
items.resolution: Failed chooser launch yields Dismissed, preventing reset authorization; ShareHelperTest covers it.

items.title: Start flow aborts with an error snackbar when session creation fails; Flutter still records attendance and opens the QR screen
items.resolution: Spec 05 risk 18 allows surfacing session-creation failure. Native stays on the organizer panel with an error and does not record successful attendance for a failed session.

items.title: VerifyPerson path tap does not fall back to njump.me when the nostr: launch throws SecurityException
items.resolution: nostr: SecurityException also opens njump fallback; NostrFallbackTest covers it.

items.title: Shared PNGs in cacheDir/share are never cleaned up (world-map images pile up)
items.resolution: Shared images expire after one hour; ShareHelperTest covers cleanup.

items.title: PortalLogoRegistry.seedFrom (crest seeding from the meetup directory) is never called
items.resolution: MeetupServiceImpl seeds PortalLogoRegistry after directory load; MeetupServiceTest covers it.

items.title: Cleartext exception for 127.0.0.1/localhost kept although the native PlebRap player uses no loopback proxy
items.resolution: Preserved both loopback policy exceptions. Compiled MempoolHosts accepts 127.0.0.1 and trailing-dot localhost.; network tests and a real loopback-server device check verify required custom-mempool usage.

items.title: Location permission is never requested: LocationPermissionBridge has no Activity collector
items.resolution: MainActivity collects LocationPermissionBridge requests and registers the ActivityResult launcher. Real API 36 system prompt, denial, retry and grant exercised.

items.title: Login-failure snackbar keeps a hard-coded German inner prefix in EN/ES
items.resolution: Typed PortalLoginFailure is localized at the UI boundary; PortalErrorLocalizationTest covers de/en/es.

items.title: Signer disconnect reloads only the identity, not the full profile (Dart calls _loadData)
items.resolution: Signer disconnect reloads the complete profile through loadData; profile ViewModel tests cover it.

items.title: Profile screen adds a gallery avatar picker and shows the local picture, which Flutter's profile screen does not
items.resolution: Profile avatar follows Nostr metadata; gallery avatar remains a Home concern.

items.title: Legacy NostrService kind-21000 sign/verify/signBadge API not ported
items.resolution: LegacyNostrService exposes kind-21000 sign/verify/signBadge; NostrLegacyServiceTest covers the facade.

items.title: nsec import error text lacks the 'FormatException: ' prefix
items.resolution: Typed localized key errors replace raw exception-prefix text. This preserves actionable failure meaning in de/en/es rather than exposing a Dart FormatException prefix.

items.title: Widget refresh worker overwrites the news row when the feed returns no article
items.resolution: Empty news refresh retains the previous widget headline; WidgetRefreshTest covers it.

items.title: Hard-coded German fallbacks 'Ort unbekannt' and 'Kurs' are shown to users without localization
items.resolution: CalendarDisplay provides resource-based place/course fallbacks; meetup and event UI use display values without altering raw matching/dedup values. CalendarDisplayTest covers three locales.

items.title: Event calendar card: badge marker is a bare icon instead of the orange chip, and the title is limited to 2 lines
items.resolution: Event cards use the native Material presentation. The badge remains represented; visual chip shape and title wrapping follow the native UI rather than Flutter pixel parity.

items.title: KeyValueStore/SecureStore are not gated by the migration, and pending Flutter secrets are never reported as Unreadable
items.resolution: Store-level migration gate and pending-key protection cover reads, observations and writes; core:data and migration regression suites cover them.

items.title: No UI for parked Flutter identities (legacy_esp/legacy_backup/legacy_recovered): no restore/export notice
items.resolution: Authenticated profile recovery lists actual derived identities, supports restore/export/discard and preserves unrelated candidates; profile and identity regression suites cover it.

items.title: Settings → Diagnose lacks 'Alte Daten erneut übernehmen' (retryNow) and the give-up action (abandonPendingSecrets)
items.resolution: Diagnostics offers explicit retryNow and confirmed abandon; settings ViewModel/UI tests cover both.

items.title: Release CI/signing pipeline from §5.2.1/§5.2.7 not implemented (cert pin, 16 KB check, mapping upload, exported allow-list, release naming)
items.resolution: Strict APK verifier, prerelease and manual signed-release workflows added. Preview signature/alignment/ABIs/mapping/exports verified locally. Actual production key/certificate pin is external.

items.title: FlutterMigration.cleanupIfEligible() is never called, so Flutter files, orphaned ESP secrets and Keystore aliases are never removed
items.resolution: MigrationCleanupStartupTask calls cleanupIfEligible after the gate; eligibility and preservation covered by migration tests.

items.title: IdentityRecovery ignores overflow recovery slots '<name>#n'
items.resolution: Recovery includes #n overflow slots and groups by derived identity; regression tests cover independently allocated slots.

items.title: Widget provider and refresh worker continue after a 10 s / 20 s gate timeout instead of awaiting the migration
items.resolution: Widget provider and refresh await migration without timing out into store access; app tests cover the gate.

items.title: Launcher label changes from '21Meetup' to 'Einundzwanzig' on update
items.resolution: Launcher label restored to 21Meetup.

items.title: Widget picker preview shows Glance's loading layout instead of a preview
items.resolution: Static real widget picker preview supplied with app label and sample content.

items.title: Lightning wallet chooser title not localized
items.resolution: Lightning chooser title uses localized de/en/es resources.

items.title: Extra exported component (PlebrapPlaybackService) beyond the §6 exported allow-list
items.resolution: Playback service remains exported for notification, lock-screen, Bluetooth and trusted system media controllers. ConnectionGate rejects untrusted controllers. Its exact service and intent filter are explicitly allowed by the APK verifier, which rejects unexpected exports or expanded filters.

items.title: No instrumented (androidTest) migration / release-variant tests
items.resolution: Five actual AndroidKeystore/legacy ESP tests and a real Flutter in-place upgrade were verified. Nine genuine R8 preview device tests pass, including JNI Schnorr, NIP-44, NIP-49, bundled ML Kit QR decoding, map, all route types, Activity recreation, actual identity/proof Hilt integration and pending-secret diagnostics navigation.

items.title: Signer and key service error messages are never localized (spec 01 §8.10)
items.resolution: Typed identity failures map to localized resources in onboarding/profile; IdentityErrorMessageTest covers translations and typed mapping.

items.title: ncryptsec import does not catch scrypt OutOfMemoryError (logN 16, 64 MiB)
items.resolution: Scrypt OOM is converted to a typed memory failure; import regression covers it.

items.title: Profile ncryptsec export does not catch scrypt OutOfMemoryError
items.resolution: Encrypted export maps scrypt OOM to actionable UI failure; export regression covers it.

items.title: "Mit Passkey sichern" step is never offered: PASSKEY_RP_ASSOCIATED defaults to false and no build sets it
items.resolution: Passkey creation remains gated until the relying-party assetlinks.json associates the actual app certificate. The configured site returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-22; migrated unwrap remains available on supported APIs. Do not enable the build flag without verified association.

items.title: App reset keeps the diagnostic 'verbose' flag (and log file) that Flutter's prefs.clear() removed
items.resolution: Reset disables verbose logging and clears diagnostic logs; ResetAppUseCaseTest covers it.

items.title: Settings sheet is a fixed 92% sheet, not draggable between 50% and 95% with an 85% start
items.resolution: Settings sheet starts at 85%, resizes from 50% to 95% and exposes TalkBack range actions; settings sheet tests cover it.

items.title: Bottom bar and scan FAB look different from the Flutter shell
items.resolution: Native Material 3 Expressive bar and scan button implement the requested native UI. Navigation behavior and all 57 route keys are retained.
